summary.en: 破甲 for magpie: dsh-purge's prompt-injection layer as gateway middleware — operator-priority system prompt (presets), the <dsh_boost> tail block, refusal detection + a single re-nudge, and thinking-tag stripping, switchable per agent and model. Ships a dashboard page (live stats, per-model success rate, live parameter tuning) and a Usage success-rate panel.
summary.zh: 破甲 for magpie：把 dsh-purge 的提示词注入层做成网关中间件——操作者优先级系统提示词（预设）、<dsh_boost> 尾部强化段、拒绝检测 + 单次加固、think 标签剥离，均可按 agent 与模型开关。自带整页看板（实时统计、按模型成功率、实时调参）与 Usage 成功率面板。
